name: Data Analyzer: Live analysis service flags planted errors in demo employee data (smoke test)
objective: Optional manual check that the screen-side analyzer, calling a running analysis service, returns results. It prints results and asserts nothing, so it only shows the call does not crash.
precondition: Skipped unless RUN_LIVE_API_TESTS is set. Needs the Data Analyzer API server running locally.

steps.action: Analyze made-up employee data with and without a dictionary
steps.data: 5 made-up employees with an age over 65, a salary under 50000 and an unlisted department
steps.expected: No assertions. Results are printed for a human to read; the test passes if no error occurs
